Olivia (mktg): Heads-up: planning a 30m webinar focused on inference cost vs latency. 20m content + 10m Q&A. Who's in?

Raj (growth): In. Topic idea: three short demos + a lightweight benchmark PDF as gated asset.

Mia (speaker-ops): Can we do Tue next week? Ill coordinate rehearsal slots. Need owners for each demo.

Sam (eng): I can do hosted demo (tail-latency / batch). Will prepare a fallback recording.

Alex (design): Ill scope 1 hero image + one-page PDF layout. Send charts by Thu.

Olivia (mktg): Landing page CTAs: watch live, download benchmark, book consult. Raj will handle promos. Mia: schedule 2 rehearsals (tech + full dress).

Raj (growth): Promo plan: announce, reminder, last-chance. Need final blurb by Thu noon.

Mia (speaker-ops): Noted. I'll book Wed 30m tech dry-run and Fri 45m full dress. We'll use pre-recorded clips if any live demo fails.
